# scira v0.3.1

## Fix

- **`scan nginx --live` no longer marks non-package NGINX binaries as Safe.**
  In v0.3.0, an OSV-confirmed distro backport (e.g. Ubuntu USN-9159-1) was
  applied to *every* discovered host binary that reported the same upstream
  version — including separate installs the package does not own (source
  builds in `/opt`/`/usr/local`, copies, custom prefixes). On mixed-install
  hosts that could mask a genuinely vulnerable install as Safe.
  The backport verdict is now tied to the exact executables the patched
  package owns (`dpkg-query -L` ownership set): only those inherit Safe.
  A binary that reports the same version but is not owned by the package
  keeps the conservative version-string verdict and is annotated
  "NOT owned by it — verify this install independently".
- Regression test added (`cargo test`): two paths reporting the same version,
  only the package-owned binary inherits Safe; plus a mixed-install e2e
  (patched apt nginx + same-version copy at /opt/nginx/sbin/nginx) that
  asserts Safe vs Compromised and the ownership annotation.

Everything else from v0.3.0 is unchanged (php / node / brotli / emudhra /
playwright / nginx profiles, MCP scanning, release binaries).
